title: Find Earliest Failure
description: List the earliest failure indicators sorted by timestamp to find the FIRST failure in a cascade. Covers container exits (EXIT_CODE=) AND process deaths (crash signals, pipe breaks), because a container exit is usually downstream of the death that caused it.
instruction: gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.pod_name:"${workload_name}-" AND ("EXIT_CODE=" OR "received by PID" OR "FailureSignalHandler" OR "lost connection to peer")' --format="value(timestamp, resource.labels.pod_name, textPayload)" --project ${project_id} --freshness=180d --limit=${limit} | sort | head -n 25

workload_name.description: The name prefix of the workload/jobset.
